title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
location: Berlin, Brandenburg; Chemnitz, Sachsen; Dresden, Sachsen
description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join a newly formed team at Staffbase that builds custom solutions — extending the functionality and capabilities of our award-winning employee communications platform to meet real customer needs. You’ll own solutions from beginning to end: shaping use cases together with stakeholders, building them across the stack, and validating them with the people who use them. You’ll also help bring structure to a growing team of mid-level engineers and mentor them along the way. We’re looking for empathetic, motivated team players who are driven by ownership and growth. Let’s talk!

As part of our tech stack, we use: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Kotlin, Go, Java, MongoDB, REST APIs & SDKs, Docker, Terraform, Selenium and Cypress, to name a few.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The team

You’ll join a newly formed team dedicated to building custom solutions that extend the Staffbase platform for our enterprise customers. We turn specific customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions — widgets, plugins, and integrations — that make our product work exactly the way each customer needs it to.

Because the team is new, there’s real room to shape how we work: to set engineering standards, bring structure to our processes, and grow together. That’s where you come in.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Own the development of custom solutions end-to-end — from technical design through implementation, testing, and release
  • Partner with stakeholders (customers, consultants, and internal teams) to define and detail use cases before development, then validate solutions and gather feedback afterward
  • Build across the stack: customer-facing UI in React and TypeScript, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third-party APIs
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and help bring structure, engineering standards, and good practices to a newly formed team
  • Work in a cross-functional, agile setup and produce high-quality, well-tested code
  • Give and receive valuable feedback in our code review process, and continuously learn and share knowledge with your peers
  • Work iteratively — pushing code frequently, keeping a healthy CI/CD pipeline, and automating where it helps

What you need to be successful 

  • Solid professional experience (typically 5+ years) as a fullstack developer, including working within engineering teams and owning solutions from concept to delivery
  • Strong frontend skills with React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, paired with solid backend experience (e.g. Kotlin, Java, or Node.js)
  • Confidence working with REST APIs and SDKs, and integrating with external systems
  • Experience mentoring or guiding less-experienced developers, and a knack for bringing structure to how a team works
  • Comfort working directly with stakeholders — you can translate business needs into technical solutions and validate them afterward
  • A strong focus on quality, clean code, testing, and continuous learning
  • Fluent written and spoken English and German — both are required, as you’ll work closely with German-speaking stakeholders and customers in the region
  • A self-starter who works well both independently and as part of a team
  • You understand and appreciate diversity and inclusivity in the workplace 

Nice to have

  • Experience with Go, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Prometheus or Grafana
  • A background in professional services, consulting, or building custom, customer-facing solutions
  • Enterprise integration concepts such as SSO, SAML, OIDC, or SCIM
  • A good understanding of REST and microservices architecture

What you'll get

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Du verbindest Frontend, Backend, APIs, Integrationen, Automatisierungen und den relevanten Tool-Stack zu einer zuverlässigen, skalierbaren Plattform und schaffst damit die Grundlage für weitere Wachstums- und Optimierungsinitiativen. Du optimierst das digitale Einkaufserlebnis datenbasiert durch A/B-Tests, Conversion-Optimierung und Experimente mit Tools wie Kameleoon oder ABlyft. Du bewertest geeignete E-Commerce-, KI- und Automatisierungstools, integrierst sie in unsere Systemlandschaft und entwickelst den Tool-Stack kontinuierlich weiter. Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Prozesse mit n8n, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Tools und nutzt auch code- und MCP-gestützte Workflows, um Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen. Du entwickelst robuste API-Anbindungen, Datenflüsse, Backend-Logiken und bei Bedarf Shopify-Apps oder individuelle Lösungen für unsere Business-Anforderungen. Du konzipierst, betreibst und verbesserst Schnittstellen zwischen E-Commerce und internen Systemen wie Accounting, Operations, CRM und Analyse-Tools. Du entwickelst unsere Shopify-Themes weiter und setzt technisch saubere, performante Frontend-Lösungen mit HTML, CSS und JavaScript um. Du stellst den zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher und verantwortest Konfiguration, Monitoring, Support und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Shops. Du übernimmst die technische Gesamtverantwortung für die Architektur, die Technologie und den Tool-Stack unseres internationalen Shopify-PLUS-Shops über 11 Märkte hinweg. Dein Profil Du hast etwa 2–3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in einem modernen E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise im Direct-to-Consumer-Bereich. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS und JavaScript im Shopify- und E-Commerce-Kontext. Du hast eine echte Leidenschaft für E-Commerce, digitale Transformation, KI-gestützte Entwicklung und Automatisierung und lieferst auch unter Zeitdruck zuverlässig in hoher Qualität. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig mit wenig Tagessteuerung, erkennst proaktiv Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt sie mit messbarem Impact um. Du bist ein pragmatischer, lösungsorientierter Builder mit Hands-on-Mentalität und arbeitest auch bei komplexen Anforderungen analytisch und strukturiert. Idealerweise hast Du mit Shopify oder Shopify PLUS gearbeitet und kennst Dich mit Shop- und App-Konfiguration aus. Erfahrung mit Magento, WooCommerce oder vergleichbaren Plattformen ist eine gute Alternative. Du kennst die relevanten E-Commerce-Systeme rund um CRM, Reviews, Analytics, Testing und weitere operative Tools. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungen, zum Beispiel mit n8n, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Tools, und bist mit code-gestützten Workflows vertraut. Du bringst ein breites technisches Verständnis für Backend-Prozesse, APIs, Integrationen und Datenflüsse mit und kannst Anforderungen über Frontend und Backend hinweg einordnen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (C1). Falls Dein Deutsch noch nicht C2 ist, sind entsprechend noch bessere Englischkenntnisse erforderlich. title: Application Software Engineer
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Application Software Teams We’re seeking an exceptional Application SW Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up. 🧠 Your day-to-day Execute software bring-up on customer hardware platforms (e.g. NVIDIA Drive, Qualcomm Ride). Port and configure Linux-based systems, QNX, and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments. Integrate and validate drivers, middleware, and boot-time configurations. Collaborate with Verification & Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, HIL, and test infrastructure. Work with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues. Implement system-level diagnostics, logging, and secure boot configuration. Develop automation for setup, flashing, health checks, and test execution on target hardware. 🧩 What you’ll be working on In this role, you’ll be responsible for the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware platforms, ensuring seamless performance across diverse SoCs and operating systems. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Verification, Release, and OEM partners to ensure smooth integration and reliable delivery. 🙌 You should apply if In order to set you up for success as an Application Software Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience. Essential 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience. Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python. Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees). Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware. Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI). Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs). Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C. Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks. Desirable Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs). Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs. Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics. Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and artifact management tools like JFrog Artifactory. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal.
